lead: "Which declaration is this expression inside" is a stamp on the table, not a field on `nvs_types::Ctx`.
body: A `current_method` beside `current_class` costs an edit at every construction site of that struct (`grep -n 'Ctx {' crates/nvs-types/src/`) for a fact one table wants. Take a mark before the body in `check::check_method` (`ExprTypeTable::inline_snapshot_mark`) and name the owner of everything recorded after it at both exits; the shape generalises to any per-declaration fact an expression-level table wants.
